policy: Pixabay is restricted by the playbook to ONE role: elemental mood beds — water, rain, clay, rock, snow, reed, dust. Never a named site, never a depiction. There is no Pixabay clip of the Bosporus breaching, of Durupınar or of a cuneiform tablet, and a clip presented as one would be a false statement about the evidence.
method: Every clip below was looked at as a thumbnail on a contact sheet (renders/tex_all_01..03.png) before it was kept or refused. A clip is kept only if it would survive the film's grade: near-black field, bone, a single ochre accent. Nothing was kept on the strength of the query that found it.

rounds.note: The queries were elemental but not dark, and Pixabay's library skews bright and commercial: turquoise pools, gold bokeh, drone-teal coastlines, a barrel wave, an erupting volcano.
Queries rewritten to say DARK and to name the material. Hit rate went from 33% to 38% and the kept clips are much closer to the palette.

refused_reasons.wrong_palette: turquoise swimming pool, teal barrel waves, gold and orange bokeh, green aurora, orange ink dispersal, purple sunsets — the playbook forbids a teal-and-orange grade and these ARE one
refused_reasons.stock_sheen: clean modern 4K drone plates of bright coastlines and blue-sky peaks; the playbook names this exactly — 'stock-footage sheen standing in for archive material'
refused_reasons.depicts_a_place: a flooded house with a red roof, a snowed-in village with a church spire, a city skyline, a desert of Joshua trees. Each one is a modern, identifiable, wrong place, and putting it under a claim about 5600 BC is a false image rather than a texture
refused_reasons.depicts_an_event_that_did_not_happen: an erupting volcano with lightning. Ararat is a dormant stratovolcano; an eruption on screen over that sentence would over-claim
refused_reasons.aspect: six clips are portrait or near-square and arrive pillarboxed into a 16:9 canvas
refused_reasons.not_a_texture_at_all: a gold ornate frame template, raw bacon, lipstick being applied, orchids, blossom branches, a composited tree-on-a-rock

shortfall_note: 26 clips against roughly 30 texture beats. The remainder is authored with the texture_field component rather than repeating a clip, which is what that component exists for. No clip is used twice.
